title: Solitaire meets Tower Defense . An attempt to use Claude to create new game concept based on popular mechanics
author: renderwolfai
selftext:
I asked Claude to come up with a new game concept based on two popular game mechanics: tri-peaks solitaire and tower defense.   
  
After some back and forth, it came up with "Firing Line". A game where you defend your keep by playing tri-peaks solitaire. Each card you cut from the pyramid fires a shot at the enemy. If you draw from the pile, the enemy advances towards your gate.   
Concept demo is here: [https://pawanp3.github.io/renderwolf-fable5-chart-toppers/fusion\_games/firing-line/](https://pawanp3.github.io/renderwolf-fable5-chart-toppers/fusion_games/firing-line/)  
  
It took some back-and-forth chatting. Initially, Claude was only making cosmetic changes when combining the games. Like, tri-peaks solitaire with images of enemy units on the cards, but the game was still just solitaire. I asked it to make the game play more 'complex', and it started added meta-layers, like progressive score targets. But it was still just solitaire, so nothing novel.   
  
Eventually, I asked it to walk through the fun aspect of each game. Once it answered that well, I asked it to come up with a new game that includes both those aspects. That led to Firing Lane - you strategize which card to cut from the pyramid based on what remains in the pile + which enemy is closest to your gate. So you sometimes sacrifice gate health in exchange for having a more solvable board, and sometimes the other way round.  
  
Disclosure: I hooked up Claude to Renderwolf's Woofy Agent to create the assets. This is our proprietary Agent. It is possible to just use GPT/Nano Banana instead, but we've generally found that to take more work and use up more tokens, which we didn't want to do for a concept pass.
